bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Warren Central High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Atlanta!

  • Travel to Atlanta!
  • Arrival in Atlanta! Meet your Landmark Leader!
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)
 

Day 2: Guided Tour of Clark Atlanta University & Morehouse College

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of Clark Atlanta University with Admissions Session
  • Group sit-down lunch 
  • Guided Tour of Morehouse College with Admissions Session
  • Guided Tour of Spelman College with Admissions Session
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Guided Tour of Georgia Tech University & Martin Luther King Jr. National Historic Site

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of Georgia Tech University with Admissions Session 
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Visit Martin Luther King Jr. National Historic Site
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Georgia Aquarium & Departure Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Georgia Aquarium 
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Warren Central High School, get ready for an unforgettable Atlanta adventure in 2026!
introText: From inspiring college campuses to iconic Atlanta landmarks, this Atlanta, Georgia experience brings history, culture, and future opportunities to life at every turn. Students will explore renowned universities like Morehouse College, Spelman College, Clark Atlanta University, and Georgia Tech while learning about campus life and admissions. They’ll also walk in the footsteps of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. and enjoy unforgettable experiences at attractions like the Georgia Aquarium. It’s the perfect mix of education, inspiration, and excitement—an experience your students will never forget!
